A01.summary: Stated by fresh wiki search excerpts: relationship response depends on relationship level and conversations can become arguments. Events excerpts contain parameterized names/roles/topics and journal counterparts. Historical review describes popup decisions and contextual relationship actions. Inferred: a reusable template/action structure explains the presentation; no internal dialogue graph, line IDs, speaker/portrait table, conditions or mutation ordering was read.

yairpg.takeaway: Use original role-aware event templates with concrete participants and effect receipts. Do not invent BitLife probability formulas from a wiki narrative.

A02.summary: Stated: historical review describes a chronological life log and interruptions for family/social news or decisions. Official help gives end-of-life ribbons and in-life achievements distinct meanings. The business FAQ adds annual reports. Internal journal IDs, history compaction, branch closure and text pools remain unread.

yairpg.takeaway: Show news, pending decisions and settled results distinctly. A biography display must not become the authoritative reward ledger.

A03.summary: Unread: engine, module layout, script/data formats, event bus, scheduler and performance implementation. Official FAQ describes complex saved structures without exposing them. No app package, decompile or game install acquired; a text UI does not prove data-driven internals.

yairpg.takeaway: PROPOSAL: isolate event selection, eligibility, decision and settlement in YAIR; this is design synthesis, not BitLife architecture evidence.

A04.summary: Stated by fresh official help: lives save as the player ages up; reinstall can lose lives/ribbons/heirlooms/achievements, and major updates can lose progress when structures change. Purchase restoration has separate account/platform routes. Not shown: serializer, version/migration policy, atomic choice persistence, backup, import/rejection handling or offline progress. Entitlement recovery is not save recovery.

yairpg.takeaway: Persist the action receipt and its consequences coherently. Preserve rejected files and distinguish restored purchases from restored character progress.

A05.summary: Stated in historical review: family members produce news as the character ages. Wiki excerpts say relationship quality influences responses; no weights are inspected. Official help ties careers to stats/education/experience. No planner, autonomous complete NPC life, faction simulation or annual resolution order established.

yairpg.takeaway: A known person can initiate a bounded event with a stated reason. Do not expose hidden temperament or invent future life facts.

A06.summary: Stated in historical review: four headline meters, assets and relationship menus surround an age-advance action and event log. Current FAQ locates products within the job menu and collections in the main menu. Actual current app screens, keyboard use and accessibility were not observed; the mobile arrangement is reference only.

yairpg.takeaway: Desktop target 1366x768/1920x1080: show known people, lived outcomes and current action side by side. Avoid making several menus mandatory for routine context; mobile is deferred.

A07.summary: Unread: developer content tools, event template files, mod API, load order and validation. God Mode edits characters/starts through a game feature; it is not a public authoring API. Community event lists describe outcomes but do not establish the shipped file structure.

yairpg.takeaway: Keep start authoring separate from ordinary in-life powers. Original event packs still need schema and reachable/refusal checks.

A08.summary: Stated: education/career decisions affect eligibility; business guidance weighs demand, competition, supplier quality/cost and paid market research. The FAQ defines capital, revenue, net income and profit margin. Lottery odds, effect weights, karma math, ribbon precedence, RNG seeds/pity and scaling remain unread. The supplied guidance is qualitative, not a formula.

yairpg.takeaway: Show the local causes of price/profit changes. Paid information should improve a decision without secretly guaranteeing success.

A09.summary: Stated: the historical age action advances to a year/event; the official business guide asks annual supplier review and end-of-year reports. Time Machine rewinds selected years, including after death. No proof of real-time aging/offline gains, exact half-year options, action-repeat budgets or event order.

yairpg.takeaway: Use safe advancement to causal boundaries and stop at decisions. A period report must account for crossed events, costs and obligations.

A10.summary: Stated: historical review introduces menus/relationships with age, while official FAQ gives education/career hints without exact hidden odds. Inferred: stage-dependent action availability can reduce early complexity. Full tutorial/unlock table is unread, so no exact age or skill gate invented.

yairpg.takeaway: Reveal a new action with a person/place and known terms. Keep ordinary paths reachable; do not require a secret challenge to use routine systems.

A11.summary: Stated: ribbons summarize a completed life; collections are revisitable from main menu. Official business glossary explains financial terms and annual reports suggest improvements. Patch notes record corpse-interaction and item-condition repairs. UI feel/accessibility and notification policies remain unread.

yairpg.takeaway: Explain domain terms near their use and show a settled life appraisal with evidence. An unavailable/dead actor must fail before presenting impossible interactions.

A12.summary: Stated: business has startup/acquisition/hired-CEO routes; products, suppliers, staff, facilities and research interact. FAQ also identifies heirlooms, achievements, ribbons, prison puzzles, deployment minigames, careers, Time Machine and character editing. The Version 1.14 guide gives child continuation versus repeating/starting anew. Full packs/current entitlement/catalogs remain unread.

yairpg.takeaway: Keep estate succession, replay and new origin separate. A chosen successor is an existing person with their own age and body, not an inherited skill bundle.
